C0.quote: citizens decide how to allocate public funds among proposed projects
C0.note: Participatory budgeting / committee selection aggregating voters' ordinal preferences; proportional core.

C1.note: Existence results for approximate core (a fairness/stability property); no strategic analysis. WD secondary only as approximation of core; could be AX alone.

C2.2.quote: Each agent i has a preference order
C2.2.note: Strict orders over outcomes (bundles of projects); special cases ranking and approval preferences over committees.

C2.3.quote: Each agent i has a preference order
C2.3.note: Preferences of voters; no separate submission.

C2.4.quote: We assume that the order is strict.
C2.4.note: Rule applied directly to preferences; abstract mentions 'submit' but no statement on reporting in the model.

C3.2.note: No statement that voters submit their held preferences.

C4.1.note: Approval case defines utility from approval set; applies since APPR input and utility used.

C5.1.quote: it ensures fairness and representation in all subgroups
C5.1.note: Proportional core / approximate core is a proportionality-fairness criterion to groups of voters.

C5.2.quote: is in γ-approximate core if for every outcome o
C5.2.note: Evaluated on the preference orders that are the rule's input; no statement relating to held attitudes.
